mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through consistent monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.0% signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST show positive growth, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), the Federal Reserve's anticipated policy response to inflation drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets price a soft landing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production index (INDPRO) values correlate with stronger manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is in the top 40% of historical values, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, accelerating corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market tightness, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high residential sales regimes (RSAFS > 400000), strong housing market activity drives consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
